target = '.....(((((((...((((...((((...((((.........(((((............)))))...))))....((((..........))))...))))...(((........)))...))))..((......))...))))))).....'
n = len(target)
# find pairs
stack = []
pairs = {}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j = stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j

# Build sequence: unpaired = A; pairs use G-C alternating, with GC clamp at closing
seq = ['A']*n
# For each helix, assign pairs. Use G-C for closing pair (outermost) and alternate
# Process helices: a helix is a set of consecutive (i,j) pairs.
seen=set()
helices=[]
for i in sorted(pairs):
    if i in seen: continue
    j=pairs[i]
    # gather consecutive stack
    helix=[]
    k=i
    while k in pairs and pairs[k]==j-(k-i) and k<j:
        helix.append((k,j-(k-i)))
        seen.add(k); seen.add(j-(k-i))
        k+=1
    helices.append(helix)

# assign: closing (first) pair G-C, inner pairs alternate C-G / G-C
for helix in helices:
    for idx,(a,b) in enumerate(helix):
        if idx==0:
            seq[a]='G'; seq[b]='C'
        else:
            # alternate
            if idx%2==1:
                seq[a]='C'; seq[b]='G'
            else:
                seq[a]='G'; seq[b]='C'
print(''.join(seq))
print(len(''.join(seq)))
EOF
